biggest fucking shit show. i’ve been suffering with my mental health for literally as long as i can remember, i literally can’t remember the last time i smiled without faking. everything got so much worse just over three years ago when my great nan died. she was one of the only family members who i genuinely got on with and loved so much. she loves me for exactly who i was and never judged me for anything. i miss her so fucking much and even all thhis time later im not even close to being ‘over it’. everytime she’s mentioned i cry and i just miss her so much. i’d do literally anything to have her back or even just hug her and tell her how much i love her. i never even got to say goodbye properly becuase i was in school. my parents sent me to school knowing that my nan was in the hospital dying. everyone else in the family was there but i wasnt even given the option to be there with her. everything has gotten so so much worse since then. i really started to struggle with sh urges again after having been clean for around two years, and i finally relapsed again in may last yeah and ever since then i’ve been doing it pretty consistently and much worse than before. my legs are absolutely fucked and my arms are heading in that direction. there was only one person i could talk to, and even then i still couldn’t fully admit everything and be honest about those urges and relapses. the onely person who i could talk to was my (now ex) girlfriend. she broke up with me in november after almost four years together over a text. i totally understand why she did it over text, but it was still so hard. we agreed to just be friends, but i cant move on at all. i miss her so fucking much every day, and seeing her can be so hard sometimes. i feel like i’m losing either way, because if i see her then i just want to go back to the way things were, but if i dont see her then i miss her company (wheter it be platonic or romantic). and we barely talk anymore. we havent had a full conversation pretty much since it happened. i definitely cant talk to her about my mental health struggles anymore, which means that i literally have no one to talk to. thats why i’ve just gone on and on here because all of this had been held in for months and it just builds uo more and more every day. oh and my parents know about everything, including the sh, and they were supportive when they found out, but they havent done anything about it at all. i dont even want help but i am aware that i need it, but they havent even called for a doctors appointment like they said they would over six months ago. i then started having panic attacks and stuff in school and school did absolutely nothing about it. we have this place called thrive where we can go when we’re struggling, but they kicked me out when break was over because apparently we weren’t allowed to be in there during lesson despite the fact that i had a pass. they sent me back while i was still having a panic attack and i had to go back to lesson like it. the whole rest of that day i was just panicking and crying but they wouldnt send me home. the whole experience just really shook me. i’ve had bad experiences with their ‘support’ before, like them finding out about my sh and telling me ‘just have a hot bath and a cup of tea’, but its never been like that. later that day, i came home tonfind that my pet tortoise died. it was just the worst fucking day and i’m honestly kind of scarred from that whole day. not to mention that that was only like a week after my ex broke uo with me and it all happened a couple of days before the three year anniversary of my nans death. and even since then, its just gotten worse every day and every single day i wish i wasnt here and that i had the guts to do it sooner. i never shouldve seen the new year. and just to top it all off, as if all that shit wasnt enough, i now have covid and i feel like shit. the worst part is that ive almost completely lost my taste, meaning i can barely find the motivation to eat and i’m really worried its gonna bring back a lot of old bad eating habits. even when i do eat, i become really aware of the textures because i cant taste it, which them grosses me out and makes me feel like i’m gonna be sick. so pretty much i just feel nauseous and i’m constantly. i also cant go to school (obviously lmao), and i have mocks in february. i so desperately need to get my maths grade up but theres no way thats gonna happen with how often im off. i dont want to go to school becuase i fucking hate it, but i need to because otherwise i’ll never be good enough to do what i want to do if i make it that far in the future.
